title: Declarative and imperative orchestration: two ways to say the same thing

videos.script: Two ways to tell a machine to make the morning report. A list of steps, or a description of what is made from what. {{ways}} Ana's shell script does every step, every time. {{script}} A Makefile says what each file is made from. Run it twice, and the second time there is nothing to do. {{make}} Edit one model, and only the models and the report are rebuilt. {{edit}} A new day fails halfway. The next run starts from the step that failed. {{resume}} dbt compares the project with a saved copy of itself, and builds only what changed. {{state}} And some steps, like sending an e-mail, will never be anything but steps.
